params._developer: Developer wallet — immutable, receives 30% of every lookup fee forever.
params._initialFee: Initial lookup fee in USDC (6 decimals). E.g. 5000000 = $5.00.
params.initialOwner: Treasury wallet — this address owns the contract and controls admin functions.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

checkExists(string).notice: Free preview: returns whether a query is flagged and the record timestamp/reporter, but NOT the evidence URL or description (those are unlocked by the paid lookupAndPay call).

claimRewards().notice: Reporter calls this to withdraw their accrued rewards.

deactivateRecord(bytes32).notice: Admin: deactivate a fake or erroneous report. The handle slot is freed so it can be re-reported.

getRecordKeysPaginated(uint256,uint256).notice: Return a paginated slice of recordKeys. Use offset=0, limit=50 then increment offset.

getRecordsByReporter(address).notice: Return keys of all records submitted by a specific reporter, newest first. Scans recordKeys — use getRecordKeysPaginated on a large registry.

reactivateRecord(bytes32).notice: Admin: reactivate a previously deactivated report. Re-indexes the handle and wallet slots.

setTreasury(address).notice: Owner can update the treasury address (the 50% cut recipient). Also transfers Ownable ownership to the new address so owner() and treasury() stay in sync.
